cover_letter.greeting: Dear BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Associate, Emerging Markets role on the GIP infrastructure deal team in New York. I am completing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli, after roles at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. GIP's mandate across energy, transportation, digital and water and waste is exactly where I want to build my career, because the capital needs of power and digital infrastructure are reshaping how these assets are underwritten.

My most relevant work is in energy project finance and valuation. For Nautilus Solar, I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan + ABS structures, and recommended a phased green loan + ABS strategy that reduced sponsor equity by $11.1M and improved levered IRR from 8.58% to 9.79%. I have also built a DCF, an LBO and trading comps for J.M. Smucker and analyzed packaged-food M&A in Capital IQ.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models evaluating $10M in capital deployment strategies and prepared executive-level investment memos for senior leadership, and at Lenovo my scenario and sensitivity analysis improved capital efficiency by 15%. I would bring that modeling discipline and clear writing to GIP's underwriting, diligence and investment committee work, and I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to the team.
